name: detail-D-opening_perimeter-door-EXT_2X6_BO-1a6812

nodes.content: CASING 11/16" x 3 1/2" mdf-casing, 3/16" REVEAL TO JAMB

notes: • Cut at D-M-ENTRY: DT-EXT-SWING36, R.O. 3'-2 3/8" x 6'-10 7/8". D-M-PORCH and D-S-BALCONY: same wall, own sills.
• R.O. starts on the 3/4" subfloor, not the joist top. The subfloor runs under the sill; the skin below stops at the datum.
• Thresholds at the cut: ENTRY 1 5/8" over the LVP, 2 5/8" over the landing; PORCH 1 1/2" / 1 9/16". BALCONY: catalog sill.
• Wall frame as at the windows: girt jamb posts on the R.O. edge, head and sill courses, 3/8" ply buck.
• Factory jambs anchor to the stud opening. The buck is a flashing substrate, not anchorage or threshold bearing.
• Sill and threshold sections are schematic until the supplier's installed section is in hand.
• Pan on the buck at the seat: sloped, back dam, end dams 6" up the jambs. Front leg runs 1/2" past the cladding to a drip.
• Panel end above the head on a perforated strip. Keep the pan outlet open: never caulk or shim across it.
K1  Jamb post: KDAT 2x4 flat, inner face on the R.O. edge, 3-1/2" past each end.
K3  Head: site-brake 24 ga steel drip cap, 1" past each casing end, end dams. Upstand stripped in.
K5  Sealant at the cladding-to-frame joint, at the mount plane, under the drip.
